title: Colorado
drawAria: Turn one card from the stock
emptyPileAria: empty pile, fill it from the stock or the waste

frontendHint.coloradoWaste: The waste card can go to a foundation
frontendHint.coloradoTableau: A tableau card can go to a foundation
frontendHint.coloradoFillGap: An empty pile can be filled straight from the stock
frontendHint.coloradoDraw: Turn a card from the stock

tutorial.foundations: There are eight foundations. The four on the left build up from the Ace (↑) and the four on the right build down from the King (↓). Together they hold all 104 cards of the two decks.
tutorial.stock: The stock turns one card at a time and there is no redeal. An empty pile can be filled straight from the stock, which saves a card of the single pass.
tutorial.tableau: Twenty piles. The waste card goes onto **any** pile whatever its suit or rank — but it buries whatever was under it. A tableau card has exactly one legal move: onto a foundation.
tutorial.controls: The controls: draw, hint, undo and so on.
